stem: A room is scheduled at maximum plant count, but HVAC, irrigation and labor capacity were sized for a lower canopy load. What is the strongest planning concern?
choices: Biological and infrastructure loads may exceed system capacity even if floor space is available
Plant count is the only capacity constraint
Lighting power automatically solves HVAC limits
Labor capacity cannot affect crop risk
rationale: Grow-space capacity is constrained by environmental control, utilities, irrigation, labor and downstream process capacity, not floor area alone.
